fields.title: Logistics and port automation reshape supply chain efficiency across GCC trade corridors
fields.seoTitle: Logistics and port automation reshape supply chain efficienc
fields.seoDescription: Arabian Travel Market and ConTech forums address automation requirements in transportation and logistics.
fields.excerpt: Automation technologies deployed in ports, warehouses and logistics networks are becoming standard practice, reshaping competitiveness of regional supply chains.
fields.content: Jebel Ali Port, Hamad Port in Qatar and Khalifa Port in Abu Dhabi are upgrading automation systems for container handling, yard management and truck routing. Warehouse automation for retail and e-commerce logistics is accelerating across the region. Companies providing robotics, warehouse management software and automated handling equipment are finding strong demand. The move from manual to automated logistics creates retraining needs for logistics workforce and restructures labour costs across supply chains.
